notes: The target MvPowerSeries.pderiv takes the coefficient ring implicitly, so MvPowerSeries.pderiv ℂ i becomes MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := ℂ) i, including in the statements of apolar_X_mul and apolar_eq_zero_of_mem_span. The definition of pderiv is otherwise identical in the pinned and target Mathlib (only `variable (R) in` was dropped), so these are the same terms and the statements are unchanged in meaning.
